# fco_public_cloud_vms (Data Source)

Lists all public cloud VMs in the project, optionally filtered by `name` and/or `labels`.

Access the results via `fco_public_cloud_vms.<name>.vms`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all public cloud VMs in the project.
data "fco_public_cloud_vms" "all" {
}

# Filter by name.
data "fco_public_cloud_vms" "by_name" {
  name = "my_vm"
}

# Filter by labels.
data "fco_public_cloud_vms" "by_label" {
  labels = {
    env = "dev"
  }
}

# access with `fco_public_cloud_vms.all.vms`
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `labels` (Map of String) Only return public cloud VMs carrying all of these labels.
- `name` (String) Only return public cloud VMs whose name matches this value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A content hash identifying the current set of listed public cloud VMs.
- `vms` (Attributes List) The list of public cloud VMs matching the given filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms))

<a id="nestedatt--vms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms`

Read-Only:

- `labels` (Map of String) A set of key/value label pairs assigned to the public cloud VM.
- `name` (String) The name of the public cloud VM.
- `size` (String) The size of the public cloud VM.
- `status_info` (String) Free-text details about the current status of the public cloud VM.
- `status_operation` (String) The current operation of the public cloud VM: `creating`, `active`, `updating`, `deleted` or `error`.
- `status_state` (String) The health state of the public cloud VM: `healthy`, `warning` or `error`.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the public cloud VM.
